Definition: Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Carmel = "garden-land"; 1) a mountain on the Mediterranean coast of northern Israel, just below Haifa; 2) a town in the mountains on the west side of the Dead Sea and south of Hebron
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
